bullets.text: AI-Powered Photo Organization - **Microsoft Photos** now auto-categorizes images using AI for easier navigation and recall.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New build 27954 enhances user experience with general improvements and fixes.
Introducing Microsoft Marketplace - A unified platform for cloud solutions and AI apps, enhancing customer engagement.
Windows ML Now Available - **Windows ML** enables local AI deployment across devices, enhancing real-time AI workloads.
Microsoft Purview Reduces Breach Risk - Implementing **Microsoft Purview** led to a 30% reduction in data breach likelihood.
